layouts.name: Circuit de Montjuïc
layouts.description: Draft configuration: The former street course follows the Estadi straight, Rosaleda and Santa Madrona bends, Guardia Urbana, Rius i Taulet and the former Marques de Comillas corridor. Current source roads provide a draft of the historical course, with modern junction alignment explicitly provisional; the internal Montanyans shortcut is excluded. Independent historical mapping corroborates the street sequence. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3788.0 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.
